svg.title: Household Pivot & Recovery Journeys (Zero Dead Ends · Era 3)
svg.desc: End-to-end journey map covering all four household meal-change paths: Home Not Cooking Tonight (Take Out, Eating out, Made plans), Home Cook Something Else (Suggestions, Search), Planner Day Pivot and Other Plans, and Direct-to-Step-2 plus Partial-Failure Recovery.
svg.text: WFS / Shared Table · Family Cookbook Era 3 · End-to-End Journeys
Pivot & Recovery Journeys — From Changed Plans to Resolution
Every path resolves cleanly in 2–3 taps without extra menus, scrolling on Pixel 10, or losing the original planned meal.

g.text: 2 taps (Take Out / Eating out) · 2 taps + inline note (Made plans)
• Take Out / Eating out → 1 tap to Step 2
• Made plans → inline note + Next → (no menu)
↻ Save for Next Week · 🗑 Remove from Sat, Nov 21
← Back returns cleanly to Step 1 (keeps custom draft)
Eating out, or custom plan card.
Preserves Quick Find & Library Search seams
User picks a new recipe for tonight.
“Choose where to keep it before saving
Move to Sun, Nov 22 · Next Week · Remove
If save fails → inline retry/review view
Journey 3 · Planner Day Pivot & Other Plans
Unified Era 3 compact shell across all 3 sheets
• Direct: Save for Next Week / Remove recipe
• Non-cook: Other plans / Edit supper plan
Fits all 5 actions with zero scroll on Pixel 10
Mystery night · Take Out · Eating out · We made plans + optional note + Save / Remove supper plan
OCCUPIED REPLACEMENT · SkipRecoveryDialog Step 2 (496px · Direct Entry)
After picking replacement recipe (Planner or Recipes “Use for day”), header shows Plan B + × without duplicate Back.
Journey 4 · Replacement Recovery States & Shared Sheet Ergonomic Invariants
• Uses same p-5 compact Era 3 shell.
• Explicit Retry save / Review plan CTA.
• Triggered only if user taps × while a replacement is partially completed or unconfirmed.
• Primary Hearth “Keep editing” (autoFocus) + Secondary “Leave replacement” (honest copy explaining
that completed moves to the original meal remain persisted).
1. Zero Horizontal or Vertical Title Jump
Locked top-left title stack across Step 1 ↔ Step 2 and Planner ↔ Other plans; [← Back]
appears beside [×] on the right, and Step 1 / Step 2 share a consistent sheet min-height.
2. Honest Visual Affordance (Cards = Clickable, Cream = Context)
Read-only recipe context sits directly on warm cream beside a 3.5px terracotta bar.
Opaque white & Hearth blush rounded cards strictly represent interactive actions.
All sheets measure 496–584px on 412×915 Pixel 10 (245–333px spare). At 320px or 200%
text scale, the 3-up tile row wraps cleanly and only the body region scrolls inside max-h.
>= 48x48px targets, 2px outline-ink-body :focus-visible, >= 12px type floor, EN + FR parity.
